title: Support tickets in a single-table store: sort keys that order wrong
name: Ticket sort keys

questions.prompt: Customers with a lot of history report that the dashboard's 'latest tickets' widget shows old tickets (like #9 and #8) above their newest ones once they pass ten tickets, and the export job returns the wrong range. Accounts with fewer than ten tickets look fine. Fix the key design so the tests pass without changing the table.
